sentence: This project studies how cells repair the DNA edits made by prime editing, so larger edits can be made more reliably.
This project builds a bone-on-a-chip model to study how prostate cancer spreads into bone that has blood vessels and nerves.
This project tries to find out how a group of bacteria builds its unusual outer membrane and moves proteins into it.
This project combines gene expression and DNA methylation data from postmortem brains to find genes linked to alcohol use disorder.
This project maintains a software tool that analyzes, labels and shows the 3D structures of DNA and RNA.
This project tries to find out what happens when blood flow to active brain cells is blocked, in health and in Alzheimer's disease.
This project supports cancer researchers with data science help, such as planning studies and analyzing their results.
This project studies how astrocytes break down mRNA and how that affects the way brain cells signal and how thinking works.
This project tests a drug in animal models to see whether it can treat a skin cancer called Merkel cell carcinoma.
This project uses an organ-on-a-chip device to study how heat exposure during pregnancy changes the placenta and fetal membranes.
This project uses organ-on-a-chip devices to study how damage to nerve fibers and brain cell connections starts in early Alzheimer's disease.
This project organizes meetings and shared support, including access to a biostatistician, for a group of related research projects.
This project tries to find out how stress signals from tumors weaken the immune system's ability to fight cancer.
This project shares cancer research results with community members and offers educational materials on cancer prevention and early detection.
This project tries to find out which genes make some dopamine neurons work differently, and builds a way to change gene expression in them.
This project tries to find out which prostate cancer patients will respond to a drug that blocks a protein, using scans and blood tests.
This project tries to make stem cells that the immune system will not reject, for treating eye diseases.
This project builds a hydrogel that slowly releases drugs to help the immune system control head and neck cancer after surgery.
This project studies how cell adhesion and energy use help frog embryo cells move together during early development.
